rationales: .HTMT is not a standard HTML file extension.
.HTML is a valid extension for an HTML page.
.XATML is not a standard HTML file extension.
.DOCX is a word-processing document extension.
Encryption is the method used by Caesar to encode messages.
Confidentiality is a security objective, not the name of the method.
Client-server over one is not a message-encryption method.
A patent protects an invention and is unrelated to encoding messages.
Passwords are used to authenticate users when they enter a system.
A web page is content, not an authentication credential.
A keyboard is an input device, not an authentication credential.
A network connects devices and is not itself an authentication credential.
SMTP is the standard protocol for sending email between systems.
HTTP is primarily used to transfer web pages and related data.
A message is the content being sent, not an email-transfer protocol.
Protocol is a general term, not the specific email protocol requested.
An algorithm is a procedure, not a command for transferring control to a step.
A flowchart is a diagram representing an algorithm, not a control-transfer command.
The goto statement transfers control to a specified step or label.
Else introduces an alternative branch in a conditional statement.
Guess, check and improve involves testing and refining possible solutions.
Divide and conquer breaks a problem into smaller tasks that can be listed and handled.
Act it out uses a physical or simulated enactment of a problem.
A prototype is an early model of a proposed solution.
RAM is volatile memory because it loses its contents when power is removed.
Non-volatile memory retains its contents without power, unlike RAM.
Indirect memory is not the standard classification for RAM.
Semi memory is not a standard memory classification.
A number system is a system for representing numeric data.
Binary is one particular number system, not the general term requested.
Decimal is one particular number system, not the general term requested.
Octal is one particular number system, not the general term requested.
TCP/IP is a protocol suite that supports communication between networked devices.
OSI is a reference model, not the protocol suite described.
IPv4 is one version of the Internet Protocol, not a complete protocol suite.
HTML is a markup language used to structure web pages.
The application layer provides network services to user applications.
The transport layer supports end-to-end message delivery between communicating devices.
The network layer routes packets between networks.
The data-link layer transfers frames across a local link.
Denial of service is one particular type of cybercrime, not the general term.
Cybercrime is crime committed using computers, networks, or digital devices.
Hard-disk loading is not the general name for a computer-related crime.
Piracy is a specific form of illegal copying, not the general term.
A virus is malicious software, not the act of illegally accessing a computer.
Hacking is the unauthorized access of a computer or system.
Piracy is the illegal copying or distribution of digital content.
Decryption is the process of converting encrypted data back into readable form.
HTML is commonly introduced through three terms: tags, elements, and attributes.
Two omits one of the three basic HTML terms.
Three is the number of basic terms commonly identified for understanding HTML.
Four includes an extra term beyond the three basic terms.
The body section begins with the opening <body> tag.
</body> is the closing tag for the body section.
<head tag is not a valid opening body tag.
</head> closes the head section rather than beginning the body section.
A communication channel carries data between connected network devices.
An address identifies a device or destination but does not carry data.
A client is a device or program that requests services.
A server provides services or resources and is not the connection medium.
